data.desc: TEN Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: XHLD), headquartered in New York is a technology company built around TEN, a Digital Experience Platform for creating, producing, engaging, marketing and measuring digital experiences, beginning with enterprise events, webinars and continuing education. TEN scales up to 50,000 concurrent attendees and is backed by more than a decade of experience producing mission-critical corporate broadcasts for Fortune 500 clients. The Company plans to expand TEN beyond events and webinars, including AI and automation, landing pages, integrations, engagement, reporting and analytics, and content studio. There can be no assurance as to the timing or availability of these capabilities.
